_comment: Example member-map for install-council.ps1 -MemberMap. Keys are the generic Council member directory names; values are the names you want them installed as in your workspace. Members not listed retain their original directory name. Pair with -CouncilName "Your Council Name" and (optionally) -RewriteReferences to also update cross-refs inside copied SKILL.md files. The mapping below is illustrative; adopt whatever job-title scheme matches your team.
